_comment: Drop a file like this into ./inbox to feed a job to the daily routine manually. Filename can be anything ending in .job.json. The routine reads, ingests (dedup), processes, then moves it to inbox/processed/. Copy this to e.g. 'acme-backend.job.json' and edit.
description: Acme is hiring an Automation Engineer to design and maintain internal workflow automations. You will build integrations across Google Workspace, Notion, and internal APIs using Make and Node.js/TypeScript. Requirements: 2+ years building automations or integrations, strong TypeScript or Python, experience with REST APIs and webhooks, comfort owning projects end-to-end. Nice to have: Make/Zapier, data pipeline experience, startup background.
